title: Evaluation: keep sample comments for the two articles whose rule is about comments
summary: Added optional keepComments list to evaluation fixtures so articles about comments themselves retain full-line comments in samples during preparation, enabling proper rule evaluation for the two affected articles.
key_points: New optional keepComments field in review-fixtures.json lets specific articles preserve full-line comments in samples
Addresses limitation where comment removal prevented evaluation of rules focused on commenting practices
Sample for test-feature-scenario-tags.bad.al was cleaned to remove comments that revealed expected outcome
Preparation still applies Good/Bad token neutralisation even with comments kept
Both affected articles (test-feature-scenario-tags and al-comments-must-not-restate) documented with keepComments entries
